import hashlib,json
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/Users/justinc/Documents/GitHub/onnax')
SOURCE=Path('/tmp/onnax-evaluation-source')
RUN=Path('/tmp/onnax-no-robots-replay')
state=json.loads((RUN/'sequence.json').read_text())
assert state['status']=='complete' and len(state['jobs'])==4
config_path=Path('/Users/justinc/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--Qwen--Qwen3-0.6B/snapshots/c1899de289a04d12100db370d81485cdf75e47ca/config.json')
config=json.loads(config_path.read_text())
components={} 
for precision in ['fp32','bf16']:
 report=json.loads((RUN/f'{precision}-comparison.json').read_text())
 assert len(report['comparisons'])==6
 with np.load(RUN/f'{precision}-torch_cpu.npz',allow_pickle=False) as cpu, np.load(RUN/f'{precision}-mlx.npz',allow_pickle=False) as mlx:
  for row in report['comparisons']:
   key=f"{row['source_engine']}__{row['seed']}__gradient"
   expected,actual=cpu[key],mlx[key]
   assert expected.shape==actual.shape and expected.dtype==actual.dtype==np.float32
   assert np.isfinite(expected).all() and np.isfinite(actual).all()
   mask=~np.isclose(actual,expected,rtol=1e-4,atol=1e-6)
   failed=int(np.count_nonzero(mask))
   shapes={name:([config['hidden_size'],4] if name.endswith('.A') else [4,config['head_dim']*(config['num_attention_heads'] if '.q_proj.' in name else config['num_key_value_heads'])]) for name in report['components'][0]['capture']['parameter_order']}
   assert sum(int(np.prod(shape)) for shape in shapes.values())==expected.size
   examples=[];offset=0
   for name,shape in shapes.items():
    size=int(np.prod(shape))
    for index in np.flatnonzero(mask[offset:offset+size])[:max(0,8-len(examples))]:
     flat=offset+int(index)
     examples.append({'parameter':name,'index':[int(i) for i in np.unravel_index(int(index),shape)],'cpu':float(expected[flat]),'mlx':float(actual[flat]),'absolute_gap':float(abs(expected[flat]-actual[flat]))})
    offset+=size
   row['pointwise_gradient']={'rtol':1e-4,'atol':1e-6,'reference':'torch_cpu','elements':int(expected.size),'failed_elements':failed,'passed':failed==0,'first_failed_coordinates':examples}
 report['pointwise_check']='numpy.isclose(mlx_gradient, cpu_gradient, rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-6), finite matching FP32 vectors'
 assert all(c['frozen_unchanged'] for c in report['components'])
 report['executions']=[]
 for engine in ['torch_cpu','mlx']:
  journal=json.loads((RUN/f'{precision}-{engine}.run.json').read_text())
  assert journal['returncode']==0 and not journal.get('guard_triggered',False)
  assert journal['source_commit']==state['source_commit']
  report['executions'].append(journal)
 components[precision]=report
sources=['training_quality_replay.py','training_quality_replay_compare.py','training_impact.py','training_quality_compare.py','reference_head.py','reference_losses.py','sft.py','nf4.py','mixed_precision.py']

Whole-process memory includes model construction, runtime sessions, validation and captured gradients.','components':components}
